scope: One real ChatGPT-started repository documentation job and recovery from a fresh ChatGPT conversation without its job ID

checks.name: README durable-job docs and links

adverseObservations: The initial recovery correctly reported the job and verification but inferred that the patch had not been applied or published. That claim was unsupported; the patch had already been applied outside the job.
Added explicit integration.state=not_observed with null applied/published values; job execution records cannot establish downstream actions.
certification: This is a bounded successful workflow, not general unattended certification or an RDC comparison.

integration.reason: This job record does not track later application, merging or publication by another actor. Do not infer either that these occurred or that they did not.

artifactReproduction.scope: Reproduces the retained artifact against its original base; does not rerun or certify the model.
